summary: No abnormal behavior detected in the application logs
explanation: The logs show normal startup and operation of multiple services without errors or warnings. The ApiGateway starts and listens on port 8080, connects to the configuration service, and successfully handles GET and POST requests with appropriate HTTP status codes (200 OK, 201 Created) and reasonable response times (4ms to 112ms). The AuthService initializes its token validation cache properly. OrderService creates orders successfully, PaymentService processes payments, NotificationService queues emails, and InventoryService updates stock levels, all with INFO-level logs indicating normal operation. There are no error, timeout, or failure messages. The rule-based anomaly detector also reports no significant anomalies.
